posts.cooked:
I finally managed all the Ultimate modes that are currently in the game. Did most of them with a team of three, usually Greatest Legacy and Super Scientific Tachyon with one other... I know, I know, that is the cheap way, but damn it Ultimate mode is hard.

Some of them were harder than I was expecting, soe of them easier. The Matriach especially was a lot easier than I was epecting, but I think I might have just got aa lucky run to be honest.

Iron Legacy, The Dreamer and Miss Information were all tricky, but I find them tricky normally, so there was no suprise there.

Ambuscade was the real shocker, Challenge mode is a big step up for him, and really opened my eyes to the danger I would be facing.

How about you guys, what are your experiences with Ultimate modes?

posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
I've been doing a run with Legacy, Parse, Hunted Naturalist, Chrono-Ranger, and KNYFE.  I got really lucky with Ambuscade and never hit a trap.  Cosmic Omnitron took a few tries, but this team is capable of doing 100+ damage in two rounds, which is enough to kill him off before everybody becomes dead.  Spite/Gloom wasn't too hard - once the team is set up taking Gloomy from 100 to 0 was easy.

I'm currently stuck on the Ennead.  Advanced and Challenge seperately are both pretty tough, and together they are ridiculous.  And it doesn't help that my team is really targeted towards taking down one huge enemy, rather than several smaller ones.  

 

For Miss Information and The Dreamer, I may use a subset of the whole team, because they are absolutely brutal against five hero teams.  But we'll see.  First I have to get past the Ennead.
